manifesto.title:
We photograph
the quiet hours
between the vows.
paragraphs: YELI is a small studio of four photographers documenting weddings, private celebrations, and editorial events across three continents.
Our work is unhurried — closer to a film still than a snapshot. We arrive early, stay late, and trust the day to give us its best moments.

chapters.title: Rooms, briefly full.
chapters.copy: Galas, launches, conferences and private charters. We document the room as it happens — the speeches, the toasts, and the hour after.
chapters.caption: Harbour party — Sydney

chapters.title: Made to be seen.
chapters.copy: Campaign and brand imagery for sponsors, products and activations — shot on location and delivered ready for print and feed.
chapters.caption: Brand detail — Awards dinner

chapters.title: Light in every room.
chapters.copy: Architectural and interior photography for listings, developments and hospitality — styled, staged, and shot at the right hour.
chapters.caption: Courtyard light

chapters.title: Two, and a vow.
chapters.copy: Five weddings a season. We arrive a day early, and we never miss the quiet hours.
chapters.caption: Lawn ceremony — Hudson Valley

chapters.title: Held still.
chapters.copy: Bridal, family and children's art portraits — in the studio or on location, with available light and patience.
chapters.caption: Candid — Sydney Harbour

pullQuote.quote: Photographs are how we stay in the rooms we leave.
